divergences.old: Every contrast command letting fetch follow any redirect, which drops Authorization on a cross-origin hop but re-sends the custom API-Key header to whatever host the Location names (#87 item 1)
divergences.toil: A redirect to another origin is refused with HTTP, naming both hosts, and nothing is sent there; same-origin redirects are followed as before
divergences.why: The organization's API key must not reach a host the user didn't configure, chosen by the server or by anything in front of it. Fixed in the port by the maintainer's decision on #87.

divergences.old: contrast libraries get reading pages of 25 until a match or a short page, with no limit on the number of pages
divergences.toil: The same stop rule, plus a bound: after 1,000 pages (25,000 libraries) the command fails with HTTP, naming the application whose libraries were being paged, and fix text to narrow the request
divergences.why: A server that ignores offset would otherwise be asked for the same page forever (#87 item 5).
